prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, major UI layout revision. Generate ONE 16:9 pixel art battle screenshot for Plants x Plants, inspired by the clean classic Pokémon battle-screen organization, using our own plant characters and depot scenery.
Input image1 is the REJECTED first mockup, use ONLY as a reference for game content, characters and environment, NOT its cluttered oversized wooden-card HUD. Image2 is the actual approved depot background. Image3 is the original Pimenta sprite, image4 original Babosa sprite, image5 a wood frame palette reference. Preserve the exact fierce plant identities, no human characters, no Pokémon creatures, no copied logos.
MAIN CHANGE requested by user: a classic bottom command menu with FOUR simple clearly organized choices in a 2x2 grid: 'Atacar', 'Trocar', 'Mochila', 'Fugir'. Atacar and Trocar enabled. Mochila and Fugir disabled, muted gray text and muted backgrounds with small 'Em breve' labels. Add a modest legible line 'Vamos implementar em breve' below the disabled entries or under the menu grid. No bag or run action is available yet. Do NOT display move names, power, accuracy, formula math, a team strip, HP of reserves, giant extra buttons or an empty fourth team slot in the root menu. Those will appear only in submenus later, NOT on this screenshot.
ART DIRECTION: Much cleaner, quieter and closer to a traditional Pokémon battle interface than the rejected image1. Spacious arena occupies upper 75 percent, one unobtrusive enemy health box upper left and one player health box lower right, no huge panel headings. Pimenta in left foreground on an elliptical soil platform; Babosa right middle-distance on a smaller soil platform, preserve frontal sprites, proportion and roots. The actual depot scenery with shelves and tools remains crisp and subdued so fighters stand out. Keep plant sprites attractive and readable, not enormous.
STATUS UI: Compact cream rectangular boxes, minimal thin stepped dark forest-green outlines, tiny restrained amber/wood edge if needed, ONE small leaf accent at most. Not thick ornate giant wood picture frames. Enemy box reads 'Babosa', small 'Guardião', slim green HP bar, '110/110'. Player box reads 'Pimenta', small 'Sua vez', green HP bar at about 76 percent, '68/89'. These boxes occupy no more than about 30 percent of screen width each and must not cover plants. No levels or XP.
BOTTOM: ONE unified horizontal dialogue-and-command panel occupying about the lower 20-23 percent of screen, inset small safe margins. A single slim amber-brown wooden perimeter matching the game's botanical UI, cream inside, tiny foliage on outer corners only, no repeating wood frames on every element. Thin central vertical divider: left 56 percent is clean dialogue area with large pixel text on two lines 'O que Pimenta' / 'vai fazer?'; right 44 percent contains the four choices in a simple roomy 2x2 grid. Atacar top left, Trocar top right, Mochila bottom left, Fugir bottom right. Use a classic small dark or orange triangular selection cursor immediately to left of Atacar, and a restrained light sage highlight. No gold glowing full-frame focus border. Disabled entries visibly subdued but readable. Buttons are simple text-led menu cells, NOT four ornate framed cards. Include tiny 'ESC · Estufa' discreetly at upper-right of arena.
TYPOGRAPHY: clean readable pixel typography close to Pixelify Sans throughout, dark forest-green letters on cream, no heavy fake bold, no modern sans-serif. Balanced proportions, thin consistent stepped edges and restrained decoration. Unified palette cream, forest green, amber and warm depot browns. No photorealism, no blurred gradients, no SaaS cards, no noisy ornamental leaves, no multiple stacked footer panels. Whole screen straight-on edge-to-edge game screenshot with no annotation, no device frame, no watermark. This version is ROOT action menu only, with attack and team selection hidden until chosen.
